headline: A Detroit, Michigan post office building is officially renamed the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building."
what_it_does: This law gives a specific U.S. Postal Service facility at 10721 E Jefferson Ave in Detroit, Michigan, a new official name. The building will be called the "Mary E. McCoy Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the name change took effect at that time.
